description: Train ML models on Databricks. Use for: classification/regression/deep-learning (XGBoost, scikit-learn, LightGBM, PyTorch) with Optuna, @prod/@challenger aliases, batch scoring (spark_udf for plain models, fe.score_batch for Feature Views-backed), custom PyFunc, custom ResponsesAgent (LangGraph + UC Function/Vector Search); feature engineering with Feature Views (Feature, create_feature, DeltaTableSource/SdpSource/StreamSource/RequestSource, RollingWindow/SawtoothWindow/SlidingWindow/TumblingWindow, compute_features, point-in-time create_training_set, materialize_features to offline Delta + Lakebase online store, streaming features, Feature Serving). NOT for: endpoint ops (databricks-model-serving), MLflow evaluation (databricks-mlflow-evaluation).
